{{Quote|Here's where you can find the island all those thugs are using as a "base". If you find you have the time, go show them what happens to traitors!|A CorSec agent, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CA" />}}
The '''Rogue CorSec Base''', also referred to as a '''Rogue CorSec encampment,''' or as '''Rogue Island,''' was a base located on an island on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], disgraced [[Corellian Security Force|ex-CorSec]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] claimed the deserted island with the old CorSec base as their headquarters for thuggery, extortion and wanton violence. The [[Rogue CorSec|Rogues]] also used the base's defense capacities to fight their former associates at CorSec, who were constantly hunting them.

==History==
{{Quote|Or not. I've got some coordinates for the source of the remote signal. Go check it out. Be careful. I'd imagine you will be walking into the heart of their operations.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mack Jasper|Jasper]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:GttSotRS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Go to the Source of the Remote Signal|Corellia}}</ref>}}
[[File:RogueCorSecBase.jpg|200px|thumb|Another view of the Rogue CorSec base]]
Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], people campaigning across Corellia to support the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] politician [[Karin Featherlight]] discovered the cave. Featherlight later uploaded the coordinates of the Rogue CorSec base to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]].<ref name="SWG:KF">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|Karin Featherlight|Corellia}}</ref> A loyal CorSec [[Agent/Legends|agent]], angered by the Rogue CorSec betrayal, also tasked a spacer with locating the base and enacting vengeance against the traitors.<ref name="SWG:CA" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a spacer working for CorSec [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mack Jasper]] infiltrated the base to find proof that the Rogue CorSec were behind a plot to overthrow [[Diktat]] [[Daclif Gallamby]]. The spacer then killed [[Hiram Bish]] and [[Mtara Vinram]], the Rogue CorSec commanders who were responsible for the plot.<ref name="SWG:GttSotRS" />

The same year, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] henchman [[Bruce McBrain]] dispatched a spacer to the Rogue CorSec Base in order to retrieve the destruction code sequences of a CorSec [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian Corvette]].<ref name="SWG:BM">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Corellian Corvette Pre-Quest: "Bruce McBrain"}}</ref> In the meantime, a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agent sent by [[Master Sergeant/Legends|Master Sergeant]] [[Crowley (Twi'lek)|Crowley]] infiltrated the base to recover sensitive [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] documents stolen by the Rogue CorSec.<ref name="SWG:MSC">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Corellian Corvette Pre-Quest: "Master Sergeant Crowley"}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Rogue CorSec Base was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RCB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
